about: The Seeker demo scanner's patterns (spec 9.2): what must never appear in demo content, whoever wrote it. Public on purpose: it holds shapes, not names. The private term list lives outside every repo and points here.

patterns.what: a platform ID (message, channel, session, user or tool call)
a GitHub address other than the demo repo's own
a claude.ai address other than a demo page stand-in or an allowed link
a 40-character hex string (a commit or a key) other than the demo CI's pinned checkout action
a path on a real machine

hidden_note: Hidden: soft hyphen, combining grapheme joiner, Arabic letter mark, Hangul and halfwidth fillers, Mongolian vowel separator, zero-width and direction marks, embeddings, overrides and isolates, invisible operators, variation selectors, the byte-order mark and tag characters. Two are part of ordinary emoji and aren't flagged: a zero-width joiner (U+200D) between an emoji and a symbol, and the emoji presentation selector (U+FE0F) after a symbol, or after 0-9, # or * before the keycap mark U+20E3. Every hidden character is still removed before the other patterns and the terms are matched.
